editorial.blurb: A cozy, unassuming Lao gem serving deeply comforting, family-style dishes that have earned passionate approval from the community.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for the Mok gai, Lao sausage, and Nam Khao—order the papaya salad with thicker ribbons of papaya rather than thin shreds, and ask for crispy fried chicken or wings to ensure texture.
